caption: A ping-pong ball is served, arcs over the net, bounces once on the far side of the table, and drops off the end.

sa.check: It bounces once on the far side of the table.
It drops off the end of the table.
The serve comes first, then the net, then the bounce, then the drop.

pc.expect: It follows a smooth arc, bounces lower than its flight, and falls off the edge.
pc.fail: It bounces higher than it came; or hovers; or changes direction in the air.

pc.expect: It goes over the net, not through it.
pc.fail: It passes through the net; or through the table; or the table passes through it.

pc.expect: It falls after the peak and off the edge.
pc.fail: It rises; or hangs; or floats.
It stays flat; or sticks; or melts.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: The ball and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour; or the net changes; or the table rearranges.
